slots.name: Michigan sentence
slots.sentence: Nassar was sentenced in 2018 to 40-to-175 years in prison after pleading guilty to seven counts of first-degree criminal sexual conduct for assaulting the athletes he treated while working for both USA Gymnastics and Michigan State University.

slots.name: Eaton County sentence
slots.sentence: He was also sentenced to 40-to-125 years in Michigan’s Eaton County, plus 60 years on federal child pornography charges.
